evals.prompt: Run the integration tests on an emulator, but invoke the run-on-emulator script with PATH set to only the directory containing 'dart' plus /usr/bin and /bin, so that the Android CLI is not found.

evals.prompt: I changed how the camera preview is initialized. Manually verify that the preview still shows up in the example app.

evals.prompt: Manually verify that the flash fires when taking a picture with FlashMode.always.
expected_chat_output: The agent explained that the emulator has no flash hardware, so this requires a physical device.
